features.heading: Discover the power of digitalization in airports
features.lead: Optimize resources, reduce costs, collect and analyze data from all ground handling processes.

items.title: Planning and forecasting
items.text: Efficient scheduling of human, GSE and fixed resources. AI-based scenarios for improved utilization of work shifts.

items.title: Data collection
items.text: Real-time tracking of ground handling services and GSE via QR/NFC scanning — every task and status captured directly from the ramp.

items.title: Accounting and budgeting
items.text: Automatic calculation of the cost of received or provided ground handling services. Simple budgeting and invoicing.

items.title: Reporting and analytics
items.text: Operational dashboards and historical performance metrics, with options for BI integration.

steps.heading: We are simplifying the process of getting started
steps.lead: Whichever solution you choose, you only need four steps to get started — and our team guides you through each of them during demo and implementation.

items.title: Upload your parameters and flight schedule
items.text: Enter your parameters, rules and work shift limitations, then upload a flight schedule — or we will connect you to any available schedule platform.

items.title: Automatically receive plans, rosters and records
items.text: Get a ready-made flight plan, shift plan and roster for all your employees, or capture every service directly from the ramp. Change any parameter and calculate any number of what-if scenarios.

image.alt: Automatically generated roster for all employees

items.title: Control your operations in real time
items.text: Receive real-time flight schedule updates about any delays and share updated assignments and tasks with your employees in our app or via WhatsApp.

image.alt: Real-Time Planning: live staff timeline, task statuses and delayed flights

phone.alt: Mobile app: an employee's roster with today's tasks and flights

items.title: Review analytics and make decisions based on actual data
items.text: Receive analytical reports with FTE, heads, paid and worked hours and more. Download them, send them automatically to colleagues or other software, or tailor them with our experts.

image.alt: Analytical report with FTE, heads, worked and paid hours per flight, shift utilization and number of shifts

about.quote: Replace legacy, paper-based processes with a unified, sustainable and highly efficient digital ecosystem.
about.heading: Built by aviation experts, for aviation operations
paragraphs: INPUT SOFT is built by people who worked in ground handling long before writing software for it. We have run ramp operations, planned resources, written handling procedures and audited quality ourselves, so we know the daily pain points, manual workarounds and limits of legacy systems firsthand.
That is why we build software around how operations actually run, and shape every module together with the teams who use it.
